items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And my mother used to play accompaniment on a piano. And by watching her and watching her, I got to where I could do that.

ctx.x: Different times. Yeah. You must have learned tunes from your daddy. Oh my lord, yes. Mississippi

Sawyer, all of those things. I can hum them for you. Gambler's Dream, all of those things. Zender. That's a new one on me. My father used to sit down and play those things on a fiddle. And my mother used to play accompaniment on a piano. And by watching her and watching her, I got to where I could do that. Because I've played ever since I was a kid. And my first tune that I ever learned to actually play on the piano was Over the Waves. And my older brother, Dick, that played the harmonica, was the one that taught…
Your mother you said went to study music. Oh yes, she was a graduate of Cincinnati Conservatory.
